description: WHAT: 1:1 mirror of a maps discovery file (UTF-8 text/JSON). summary ≡ line window + trailing # MCP-META (truncated, totalUrls, nextOffset) — not a one-line stub. which is required — common ids: ard, ai-catalog, ai-txt, ai-plugin, answer-engine, agent-skills, llms, llms-full, llms-index, llms-keywords, llms-serp, llms-jsonld, llms-navigation, llms-impressum-kontakt, llms-orte-geo, llms-grenzen-koordinaten, llms-urheberrecht, llms-copyright, llms-mcp-server, llms-mcp-web, robots, sitemap-txt, sitemap-xml. Omit limit: if remaining >~30KB → first ~30KB window + nextOffset (O9); explicit limit keeps line window 1..10000 (not forced to 30KB). USE for agent-ready catalogs and robots/sitemap. DOES NOT invent missing files (missing=true). NEXT: find_by_keyword / find_by_serp for structured search; get_llms_txt / get_ai_txt aliases.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return after offset. Omit or null = if remaining payload ≤~30KB return all remaining lines; if larger, return first ~30KB window + nextOffset (O9). Explicit limit keeps 1..10000 line window (MCP caps unchanged — not forced to 30KB). Meta also as trailing # MCP-META lines in summary.

offset.description: 0-based index into a list or discovery file lines (split on \n). 0 = first. Omit = 0. Combine with limit to page. Use nextOffset / offset+limit from a previous result when present.

which.description: Required discovery id. Examples: ard, ai-catalog, ai-txt, ai-plugin, answer-engine, agent-skills, llms, llms-full, llms-index, llms-keywords, llms-serp, llms-jsonld, llms-navigation, llms-impressum-kontakt, llms-orte-geo, llms-grenzen-koordinaten, llms-urheberrecht, llms-copyright, llms-mcp-server, llms-mcp-web, robots, sitemap-txt, sitemap-xml.
